status.description: available: start_url sets one up; has_inbox: the business already runs one; unavailable: not for this domain now, with why.

start_url.description: The setup page, with the domain and nothing else in it. The owner opens it and types their own email; nothing is signed up by this call.

host.description: Where the inbox goes live once the owner adds one DNS record: inbox.<domain> unless they pick another.

why.description: ours: an address of Surfing Dog's; hosting_suffix: an address at a hosting platform, where no DNS record can be added; health: health practices wait for now; off: not offered by this network now.

platform.description: The hosting platform's suffix, for hosting_suffix.

self_host.description: The open-source inbox, to run on the business's own servers instead.

detail.description: What to tell the owner, in a few sentences.
